convention.rig: VRM 1.0 normalized humanoid bones (three-vrm getNormalizedBoneNode). VRM 0.x models: apply VRMUtils.rotateVRM0, then negate the X and Z of every rotation and of hipsOffset, because their normalized bones keep the model frame that faces -Z (three-vrm createVRMAnimationClip does the same). Verified by rendering Sendagaya_Shibu in spec poses (artifacts/vrm_poses.png). Gaze sign on VRM 0.x is not verified.
convention.axes: +Y up, +Z the way she faces, +X her left. Camera on +Z looking at -Z, turned camera.yawDeg around Y (orthographic).
convention.euler: degrees, order XYZ as three.js Euler (matrix = Rx*Ry*Rz), in the normalized local space, relative to the T-pose (identity). lowerArm is a hinge: only its Y channel moves (X and Z stay 0 +/- 5). Humeral rotation is upperArm.x; forearm pronation and supination are hand.x.
convention.composition: final local euler = rest + sum(idle layers * idleWeight(t)) + action delta, per channel. idleWeight ramps over idle.rampMs at rest ends (lib/compose.mjs).

signs.upperLegZ: + moves the right foot toward her left (adduction of the right leg)

convention.curves: Each track is a list of keys [tMs, value, flags?]; monotone cubic Hermite (Fritsch-Carlson) per channel; tangent 0 at the first and last key and at keys flagged "h". Before the first key the first value holds; after the last, the last value.
convention.fingers: [curl, spread, thumbCurl] deltas added to rest.fingers; a rig maps curl c to each finger joint X = c * [55, 75, 45] deg (proximal, intermediate, distal), spread s to proximal Z = s * [-8,-3,3,8] across index..little, thumb t to thumb joints = t * [20, 35, 40].
convention.gaze: [yawDeg, pitchDeg] relative to straight ahead of the head; +yaw her left, +pitch up. VRM: lookAt.yaw/pitch (or a lookAt target placed on that ray). 2D: shift the iris layer.
convention.expressions: VRM 1.0 preset names (happy, relaxed, surprised, aa, ih, ou, ee, oh, blink). Values are deltas added to rest.expressions, clamped to 0..1.
convention.hipsOffset: metres, added to the hips position (dip, lift).
convention.twoD: Layered 2D rig (lib/layer2d.mjs): run FK, project with camera.yawDeg. Each limb drawing is pinned at its projected joint, rotated to the projected bone angle, and stretched along the bone by ratio / variant.nominal, where ratio = projected length / true length; the variant is picked from twoD.parts[p].variants by ratio and depth (toward or away from the camera). Head, torso and pelvis pick a turn view by camera-relative yaw and pitch and shift their face parts by parallax between views. Draw order: sort parts by camera depth of their midpoints every frame.

skeleton.note: Proportions used by the checker and preview (1.60 m). A real rig keeps the angles and re-solves the contacts in rest.contacts with its own IK.

contacts.leftHand: heel of the hand on the left iliac crest, fingertips forward-down on the hip (lib/body.mjs pelvis profile)
contacts.rightHand: free, palm toward the thigh, 3-5 cm off it

idle.note: Always on, added on top of rest and of any action. A clip lowers it per bone with idleWeight (bones it drives default to drivenWeight, bones it does not drive keep 1). At every section end that touches rest, the weight ramps between 1 and the clip weight over rampMs with smoothstep, so the pose never steps when a clip starts or ends (lib/compose.mjs idleBlend).

blink.note: Uniform 2-6 s gives ~15 blinks/min (adult resting rate 15-20/min, guess-level source). Skipped while sleep owns the eyelids.

saccade.note: Eyes jump first (45 ms), head follows 30 % of the gaze change after 150 ms over 420 ms (eye-head coordination).

spriteBake.note: Degraded sprite fallback only (not shipped). A sprite cannot add layers per bone: breath becomes 4 body frames; weight sway and head drift are lost. The checker reports what this costs (fallback block). The shipped layered2d rig evaluates the idle layer live, so sway, drift and breath all run.

loop.note: Mouth tracks are the fallback pattern. When speech reports boundaries or audio level, drive aa/ih/ou/ee/oh from it and keep the body tracks.
Breath slows to 5.2 s and deepens; the idle breath layer is muted (idleWeight) so the two do not stack.

stateMachine.note: Binds clips to the real events in src/pet/Pet.svelte. One body clip plays at a time; blink and saccade events and mouth visemes layer on top. lib/behaviour.mjs is the reference implementation of these rules; the checker runs it on scenarios that reproduce Pet.svelte call order.

wordShownRevealed.note: Talk loops while speech plays (speakStart..speakEnd); without speech, one loop then exit (min 1.6 s).

reveal.source: Pet.svelte reveal() (2600 ms timer, Pet.svelte:221, or Bubble onreveal)

speakStart.source: NEW: speech start signal at both speak() call sites (Pet.svelte:222, 423)
speakStart.mouthOverlay: visemes start at once even when the body talk is queued behind a lock

speakEnd.source: NEW: utterance.onend / onerror (system) or audio ended / error (http, pack) in src/lib/speech/index.ts. Not the speak() promise: it resolves when speech starts.

known.note: nextNow() shows the next word after SWAP_MS (1500 ms); its talk queues until happy ends.

hoverBubble.note: Gaze only: eyes and 30 % head toward the bubble; no clip.

click.source: sprite onpointerup without drag (onSpriteUp -> resume, Pet.svelte:272-280)
click.note: resume() -> nextNow() -> advance() may call showNext() in the same tick; that talk queues until the nod ends.

dragEnd.source: win.onMoved quiet for 250 ms (Pet.svelte:366-373), or the 1200 ms fallback (Pet.svelte:269)

userBack.source: wake() when the sleep condition clears (Pet.svelte:187), or resume() by click (Pet.svelte:278)
userBack.note: loop() calls wake() then advance() in the same tick; the word talk queues until wake and wave end.

fullscreenHide.note: Hidden: cancel every clip and timer, reset to rest (nobody sees it).

fullscreenShow.source: visible again -> win.show() (Pet.svelte:324); NEW: remember hiddenSince

appStart.note: scheduleTick(1500) shows the first word at 1.5 s, mid-wave; that talk queues until the wave ends.

idleTick.source: NEW idle scheduler (replaces idleLoop, Pet.svelte:289-297): every 6-14 s while nothing plays
idleTick.note: Blink is not picked here: it is procedural in the idle layer (idle.events.blink).

interrupt.rule: A request with higher priority than the playing clip preempts it, unless a lock holds. A request that cannot play queues if its priority >= queue.minPriority, else it is dropped.

lock.note: A locking event (click, reveal, known, userBack, appStart, fullscreenShow) holds its clip and its then-chain against every request below breakPriority. Only drag and sleep break it.

queue.note: Expiry covers the longest one-shot (breathe 3100 ms) and the longest locked chain (sleep exit 1500 + wave 2650 = 4150 ms).

exit.note: On release a loop finishes its cycle if the boundary is within 400 ms, else it blends into the exit at once over 200 ms.

interrupt.preemptBlend: Crossfade in pose space from the current sampled pose into the new clip over interruptExitMs (default 250 ms, ease in-out).
interrupt.statefulExit: A stateful clip ends by playing its exit section, never by snapping. maxMs forces the exit if the hold event never comes.

frame.note: Image x = originXPx + projected x * pxPerM, image y = originYPx - projected y * pxPerM (y down). Derived from the union box of every sampled pose plus the skin margin; the checker re-derives the fit.

head.note: One head+hair drawing per (yaw, pitch) view; eyes, brows and mouth are separate parts placed by a per-view anchor and shifted by parallax between views.

twoD.ladder: Limb variants: nominal ratios 1.0 / 0.64 / 0.41 / 0.26 (each covers +/-25 %), split by depth below 1.0, plus an end-on drawing for ratio <= 0.21. Only the rungs the motion uses are listed.

layered2d.note: Decoded atlas RAM, flat whatever the number of actions. Work per frame: FK of 25 bones, ~30 canvas drawImage calls; 30 fps while visible, nothing runs when hidden. Measured in headless Chrome by measure_ram.mjs (artifacts/ram.json).

vrm.note: three.js + three-vrm + a VRoid model. Decoded textures alone exceed the cap; shipping it needs the lead to approve the measured RAM.

sprite.note: Emergency fallback only (rig failed to load). The checker measures what it breaks at its own fps; see the fallback block of its output and artifacts/fallback-sweep.json.
